NEGROS POWER ADVISORY
MANUAL LOAD DROPPING (MLD) SCHEDULE 
October 19, 2026 (Monday)
As per NGCP, in their advisory today via https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1C9GQdtcPv/, Manual Load Dropping (MLD) has been implemented due to limited generation supply from Mindanao.
Factor/s that contributed to the RED and YELLOW Alert declarations:
1. Unavailability of Visayas' large coal plants TVI 1, TVI 2, and PEDC 3
2. Limited power import from the Mindanao Grid
At present, the following feeders are being considered for possible MLD implementation (refer to the photo provided). In the meantime, the following are the actual areas that are currently offline:
Murcia Feeder 3
Time Offline: 5:37 PM
Time Online: 
Affected areas: Murcia (Salvacion – Lopues area, Talotog, Abo-Abo – portion, Buenavista, Iglauan, Caliban, Lopez Jaena, Santa Rosa, San Miguel, Minoyan, Amayco, Pandanon), Don Salvador Benedicto (Pandanon, Igmaya-an, Kumaliskis, Bunga, Bagong Silang, Bago), Sitio Tabucol, Spur 16
**
Talisay Feeder 1 
Time Offline: 5:39 PM
Time Online: 
Affected areas: Menlo Heights Plaza, Menlo Garden Phase II, III and IV, Brgy Zone 4, 4A, 5, 12, 12A, 6, 10, Talisay Public Market, SM Savemore Talisay, CHMSC, EELMS, TES, TESDA, TUP, RBLMHS, Menlo Village 4, Menlo Garden, Tali Homes, Carmela Valley Subd., Carmela Valley Executive
Brgy Zone 1,2,3, Portion Zone 16, Bubog, St. Paul's Village, Pacific Shores Subd., Buen Retiro Subd., Kooll Company
**
Lopez Feeder 1 
Time Offline: 5:40 PM
Time Online: 
Affected areas: Caneland (AIDSISA), Mansiguinon, Brgy. Kapitan Ramon, Brgy. Patag, E. Lopez, Hda. Pula, Hda. Napilas 1,2,6,7,  Sitio Hiyang2x, Tayap Proper, Macamig 1-3, Hda. Caridad, Hda. Napilas 1-3, Hda. San Gregorio, Hda. Marigasa 1-3, Hda. Paz.
Please be advised that the schedule, duration, and affected feeders may change at any time, depending on the actual condition of the power system and/or further directives from NGCP.
Negros Power continues to closely coordinate with NGCP and will provide updates as necessary.
To know which feeder you are connected, please refer to the link: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18oNLoVaqA/
For the latest information and updates, please refer to the official posts of Negros Power on our Facebook page. We encourage the public to regularly check our official posts for any changes to the MLD schedule, affected feeders, and other related advisories.
We sincerely ask for your understanding, patience, and cooperation as these measures are being implemented to help maintain the stability of the power grid.
#NegrosPower #VisayasGrid #NGCP #AlertLevels #ManualLoadDrop
